notes.text: Blitz Split on Apple Watch: connect it to your iPhone's account, see your balances and open groups, tap I paid in a group where you owe, and add your overall balance to a watch face or the Smart Stack; once connected, the watch works on its own.
The app now speaks Bengali, Malay and Greek: pick "বাংলা", "Bahasa Melayu" or "Ελληνικά" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
Groups can now use the Bangladeshi taka and the Malaysian ringgit.
The app now speaks Croatian: pick "Hrvatski" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
The app now speaks Filipino: pick "Filipino" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
Groups can now split in the Philippine peso (PHP, "₱"), and a group made in the Philippines starts in it.
The app now speaks Hungarian: pick "Magyar" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
Groups can now use the Hungarian forint.
Add the Balances widget to the Home Screen or Lock Screen of your iPhone or iPad to see your overall balance and your open groups at a glance; tap it to open Balances.
Groups can now use the currencies of Bolivia, Venezuela, Costa Rica, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, the Dominican Republic and Cuba, and a group created there starts in its own.
The app now speaks Serbian: pick "Srpski" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
Groups can now split in the Serbian dinar (RSD), and a group made in Serbia starts in it.
The app now speaks Urdu: pick "اردو" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
Groups can now split in the Pakistani rupee (PKR), and a group made in Pakistan starts in it.
Tapping the notification of a new bill opens the bill right away: the app brings it in as soon as the notification arrives.
The welcome screen on phones now shows just the logo at the top, leaving more room for the buttons.
The group's "Time to settle up" banner no longer shows a reminder date from before the reminder was set or changed: a reminder changed to the 25th waits for the 25th.
